void emit(string text)
    println(text)

bool has_word(string[] items, string value)
    for item := items[]
        if item == value
            return true
    return false

nat position(string[] items, string value)
    for: item := items[i]
        if item == value
            return i
    return #items

bool has_day(int[] items, int value)
    for item := items[]
        if item == value
            return true
    return false

int sum_numbers(int[] items)
    result := 0
    for item := items[]
        result += item
    return result

int maximum(int[] items)
    result := items[0]
    for item := items[]
        if item > result
            result = item
    return result

int minimum(int[] items)
    result := items[0]
    for item := items[]
        if item < result
            result = item
    return result

string signed_text(int value)
    return (if value >= 0 then "+" else "") + "{value}"

string decimals(int numerator, int denominator)
    cents := numerator * 100 / denominator
    return "{cents / 100}.{cents % 100:02.}"

string name_list(string[] items)
    return if #items == 0 then "none" else items.sorted().join(" ")

bool leap_year(int year)
    return year % 400 == 0 or (year % 4 == 0 and year % 100 != 0)

int[] month_lengths(int year)
    return [31, if leap_year(year) then 29 else 28, 31, 30, 31, 30, 31, 31, 30, 31, 30, 31]

int | error parse_date(string text)
    year := int(text[:<4])
    month := int(text[5:<7])
    day := int(text[8:])
    if month < 1 or month > 12
        return error("invalid date {text}")
    lengths := month_lengths(year)
    if day < 1 or day > lengths[nat(month - 1)]
        return error("invalid date {text}")
    result := day - 1
    for: 2000 <= y < year
        result += if leap_year(y) then 366 else 365
    for: 1 <= m < month
        result += lengths[nat(m - 1)]
    return result

string date_text(int ordinal)
    year := 2000
    rest := ordinal
    while rest >= (if leap_year(year) then 366 else 365)
        rest -= if leap_year(year) then 366 else 365
        year += 1
    lengths := month_lengths(year)
    nat month := 0
    while rest >= lengths[month]
        rest -= lengths[month]
        month += 1
    weekday := ["Mon", "Tue", "Wed", "Thu", "Fri", "Sat", "Sun"][(ordinal + 5) % 7]
    return "{year:04.}-{month + 1:02.}-{rest + 1:02.} {weekday}"

class WorkTask(int base, string resource, int units)
    not_before := 0
    crash_limit := -1
    crash_cost := 0
    crashed := 0
    int[] estimate := []

    int current_duration()
        return base - crashed

class Dependency(string a, string b, string kind, int lag)
class Schedule(string[] names, int[] durations, int[] es, int[] ef, int[] ls, int[] lf, int[] tf, int[] ff, int project_length)
    nat at(string name)
        return position(names, name)

    bool critical(string name)
        return tf[at(name)] == 0

    string[] critical_names()
        return [for i := names.indices()[] if tf[i] == 0 then names[i]]

    int margin(Dependency dep)
        nat first := at(dep.a)
        nat last := at(dep.b)
        if dep.kind == "FS"
            return es[last] - ef[first] - dep.lag
        if dep.kind == "SS"
            return es[last] - es[first] - dep.lag
        return ef[last] - ef[first] - dep.lag

    int[] fields(string name)
        nat index := at(name)
        return [es[index], ef[index], ls[index], lf[index], tf[index], ff[index]]

    string[] by_start()
        string[] result := []
        for name := names[]
            nat index := 0
            while index < #result and es[at(result[index])] <= es[at(name)]
                index += 1
            result = result[:<index].append(name).concat(result[index:])
        return result

int start_bound(Dependency dep, string[] names, int[] starts, int[] finishes, int duration)
    index := position(names, dep.a)
    if dep.kind == "FS"
        return finishes[index] + dep.lag
    if dep.kind == "SS"
        return starts[index] + dep.lag
    return finishes[index] + dep.lag - duration

int finish_bound(Dependency dep, string[] names, int[] starts, int[] finishes, int duration)
    index := position(names, dep.b)
    if dep.kind == "FS"
        return starts[index] - dep.lag
    if dep.kind == "SS"
        return starts[index] - dep.lag + duration
    return finishes[index] - dep.lag

class Project()
    tasks := map<string, WorkTask>()
    Dependency[] dependencies := []
    start_date := -1
    int[] holidays := []
    deadline_date := -1
    capacities := map<string, int>()
    baseline_set := false
    baseline := Schedule([], [], [], [], [], [], [], [], 0)

    string[] task_names()
        return tasks.keys().sorted()

    WorkTask get_task(string name)
        match tasks.get(name)
            WorkTask value
                return value
            none
                return WorkTask(1, "", 0)

    void | error check_task(string name)
        if not tasks.has(name)
            return error("unknown task {name}")
        return void

    Dependency[] pred_links(string name)
        Dependency[] result := []
        for other := task_names()[]
            for dep := dependencies[]
                if dep.a == other and dep.b == name
                    result = result.append(dep)
        return result

    Dependency[] succ_links(string name)
        Dependency[] result := []
        for other := task_names()[]
            for dep := dependencies[]
                if dep.a == name and dep.b == other
                    result = result.append(dep)
        return result

    string[] topological()
        string[] pending := task_names()
        string[] result := []
        while #pending != 0
            selected := ""
            for name := pending[]
                ready := true
                for dep := pred_links(name)[]
                    if has_word(pending, dep.a)
                        ready = false
                        break
                if ready
                    selected = name
                    break
            if selected == ""
                return result
            result = result.append(selected)
            pending = [for name := pending[] if name != selected then name]
        return result

    string cycle_notation(string[] order)
        string[] remaining := [for name := task_names()[] if not has_word(order, name) then name]
        walk := [remaining[0]]
        while true
            previous := ""
            for dep := pred_links(walk[-1])[]
                if has_word(remaining, dep.a)
                    previous = dep.a
                    break
            at := position(walk, previous)
            if at < #walk
                string[] cycle := [previous].concat(walk[at + 1:][::-1])
                first := cycle.sorted()[0]
                index := position(cycle, first)
                cycle = cycle[index:].concat(cycle[:<index])
                return cycle.append(cycle[0]).join(" -> ")
            walk = walk.append(previous)

    string[] | error analysis_order()
        if tasks.size() == 0
            return error("no tasks")
        string[] result := topological()
        if #result < tasks.size()
            return error("cycle {cycle_notation(result)}")
        return result

    Schedule compute_schedule(string[] order, changed := "", replacement := 0)
        string[] names := task_names()
        int[] durations := [for name := names[] then if name == changed then replacement else get_task(name).current_duration()]
        es := array(#names, fill = 0)
        ef := es
        ls := es
        lf := es
        for name := order[]
            index := position(names, name)
            int start := get_task(name).not_before
            for dep := pred_links(name)[]
                bound := start_bound(dep, names, es, ef, durations[index])
                if bound > start
                    start = bound
            es[index] = start
            ef[index] = start + durations[index]
        project_length := maximum(ef)
        for name := order[::-1][]
            index := position(names, name)
            finish := project_length
            for dep := succ_links(name)[]
                bound := finish_bound(dep, names, ls, lf, durations[index])
                if bound < finish
                    finish = bound
            lf[index] = finish
            ls[index] = finish - durations[index]
        tf := [for i := (nat(0):<#names)[] then ls[i] - es[i]]
        ff := [for i := (nat(0):<#names)[] then project_length - ef[i]]
        result := Schedule(names, durations, es, ef, ls, lf, tf, ff, project_length)
        for: name := names[i]
            for dep := succ_links(name)[]
                value := result.margin(dep)
                if value < ff[i]
                    ff[i] = value
        result.ff = ff
        return result

    string[][] critical_walk(Schedule result, string[] path)
        name := path[-1]
        string[][] paths := []
        for dep := succ_links(name)[]
            if result.critical(dep.b) and result.margin(dep) == 0
                paths = paths.concat(critical_walk(result, path.append(dep.b)))
        return if #paths == 0 then [path] else paths

    string[][] critical_paths(Schedule result)
        string[][] paths := []
        for name := result.critical_names()[]
            root := true
            for dep := pred_links(name)[]
                if result.critical(dep.a) and result.margin(dep) == 0
                    root = false
            if root
                paths = paths.concat(critical_walk(result, [name]))
        return paths

    string[] resources()
        string[] result := []
        for name := task_names()[]
            string resource := get_task(name).resource
            if not has_word(result, resource)
                result = result.append(resource)
        return result.sorted()

    int[] usage(string resource, string[] names, int[] starts, int[] finishes, int length)
        result := array(nat(length), fill = 0)
        for: name := names[i]
            WorkTask task := get_task(name)
            if task.resource == resource
                for: starts[i] <= day < finishes[i]
                    result[nat(day)] += task.units
        return result

    bool working_day(int day)
        return (day + 5) % 7 < 5 and not has_day(holidays, day)

    int[] working_dates(int count)
        int[] result := []
        day := start_date
        while #result < nat(count)
            if working_day(day)
                result = result.append(day)
            day += 1
        return result

    int work_between(int after, int until)
        result := 0
        for: after + 1 <= day <= until
            if working_day(day)
                result += 1
        return result

    int capacity_for(string resource, int fallback)
        match capacities.get(resource)
            int value
                return value
            none
                return fallback

    void calendar_report(Schedule result)
        int[] dates := working_dates(result.project_length)
        for name := result.by_start()[]
            index := result.at(name)
            emit("{name} {date_text(dates[nat(result.es[index])])} - {date_text(dates[nat(result.ef[index] - 1)])}")
        first := dates[0]
        last := dates[-1]
        emit("project {date_text(first)} - {date_text(last)}, {result.project_length} working days, {last - first + 1} calendar days")
        if deadline_date >= 0
            if last <= deadline_date
                emit("deadline {date_text(deadline_date)} met, {work_between(last, deadline_date)} working days to spare")
            else
                emit("deadline {date_text(deadline_date)} missed by {work_between(deadline_date, last)} working days")
        spanned := [for day := holidays.sorted()[] if (day + 5) % 7 < 5 and day >= first and day <= last then date_text(day)]
        emit("holidays in span: " + (if #spanned == 0 then "none" else spanned.join(", ")))

    void | error level_report(Schedule result, int limit)
        string[] names := task_names()
        for name := names[]
            WorkTask task := get_task(name)
            int capacity := capacity_for(task.resource, limit)
            if task.units > capacity
                return error("capacity {capacity} too small for {name}")
        string[] decided := []
        starts := array(#names, fill = 0)
        finishes := starts
        while #decided < #names
            chosen := ""
            for name := names[]
                if has_word(decided, name)
                    continue
                ready := true
                for dep := pred_links(name)[]
                    if not has_word(decided, dep.a)
                        ready = false
                if ready and (chosen == "" or result.ls[result.at(name)] < result.ls[result.at(chosen)])
                    chosen = name
            WorkTask task := get_task(chosen)
            index := position(names, chosen)
            duration := task.current_duration()
            start := task.not_before
            for dep := pred_links(chosen)[]
                bound := start_bound(dep, names, starts, finishes, duration)
                if bound > start
                    start = bound
            while true
                available := true
                for: start <= day < start + duration
                    used := 0
                    for name := decided[]
                        other := position(names, name)
                        WorkTask old := get_task(name)
                        if old.resource == task.resource and starts[other] <= day and day < finishes[other]
                            used += old.units
                    if used + task.units > capacity_for(task.resource, limit)
                        available = false
                        break
                if available
                    break
                start += 1
            starts[index] = start
            finishes[index] = start + duration
            decided = decided.append(chosen)
        length := maximum(finishes)
        emit("level capacity {limit}: duration {result.project_length} -> {length}")
        for name := decided[]
            index := position(names, name)
            emit("{name} start {starts[index]} finish {finishes[index]} shift {starts[index] - result.es[index]}")
        for resource := resources()[]
            before := maximum(usage(resource, names, result.es, result.ef, result.project_length))
            after := maximum(usage(resource, names, starts, finishes, length))
            emit("resource {resource} capacity {capacity_for(resource, limit)} peak {before} -> {after}")
        return void

    void .crash_project(string[] order, int budget)
        remaining := budget
        nat steps := 0
        Schedule result := compute_schedule(order)
        initial := result.project_length
        reason := ""
        while true
            chosen := ""
            for name := task_names()[]
                WorkTask task := get_task(name)
                if result.critical(name) and task.crash_limit >= 0 and task.crashed < task.crash_limit
                    if compute_schedule(order, name, task.current_duration() - 1).project_length < result.project_length
                        if chosen == "" or task.crash_cost < get_task(chosen).crash_cost
                            chosen = name
            if chosen == ""
                reason = "no candidate"
                break
            WorkTask task := get_task(chosen)
            if task.crash_cost > remaining
                reason = "insufficient budget"
                break
            previous := task.current_duration()
            task.crashed += 1
            .tasks.set(chosen, task)
            remaining -= task.crash_cost
            steps += 1
            result = compute_schedule(order)
            emit("step {steps}: {chosen} {previous} -> {task.current_duration()}, cost {task.crash_cost}, project {result.project_length}")
        emit("crash done: {steps} days, cost {budget - remaining}, project {initial} -> {result.project_length}, budget left {remaining}, {reason}")

    void | error .execute(string line)
        words := line.split(" ")
        command := words[0]
        args := words[1:]
        if command == "TASK"
            if tasks.has(args[0])
                return error("task {args[0]} already exists")
            .tasks.set(args[0], WorkTask(int(args[1]), args[2], int(args[3])))
            emit("task {args[0]} added")
        elif command == "DEP" or command == "UNDEP"
            try check_task(args[0])
            try check_task(args[1])
            at := #dependencies
            for: dep := dependencies[i]
                if dep.a == args[0] and dep.b == args[1]
                    at = i
                    break
            if command == "DEP"
                if args[0] == args[1]
                    return error("self dependency {args[0]}")
                if at < #dependencies
                    return error("dependency {args[0]} -> {args[1]} already exists")
                lag := int(args[3])
                dependencies = dependencies.append(Dependency(args[0], args[1], args[2], lag))
                emit("dependency {args[0]} -> {args[1]} {args[2]}{signed_text(lag)} added")
            else
                if at == #dependencies
                    return error("no dependency {args[0]} -> {args[1]}")
                dependencies = dependencies[:<at].concat(dependencies[at + 1:])
                emit("dependency {args[0]} -> {args[1]} removed")
        elif command == "REMOVE"
            try check_task(args[0])
            old := #dependencies
            dependencies = [for dep := dependencies[] if dep.a != args[0] and dep.b != args[0] then dep]
            bool removed := .tasks.remove(args[0])
            emit("task {args[0]} removed with {old - #dependencies} dependencies")
        elif command == "NOTBEFORE" or command == "CRASHCOST" or command == "UNCRASH" or command == "PERT"
            try check_task(args[0])
            WorkTask task := get_task(args[0])
            if command == "NOTBEFORE"
                task.not_before = int(args[1])
                emit("notbefore {args[0]} {args[1]}")
            elif command == "CRASHCOST"
                limit := int(args[1])
                if limit >= task.base
                    return error("crash limit too large for {args[0]}")
                if limit < task.crashed
                    return error("crash limit below used days for {args[0]}")
                task.crash_limit = limit
                task.crash_cost = int(args[2])
                emit("crash {args[0]} max {limit} cost {args[2]}")
            elif command == "UNCRASH"
                emit("uncrash {args[0]} restored {task.crashed} days")
                task.crashed = 0
            else
                o := int(args[1])
                m := int(args[2])
                p := int(args[3])
                if not (o <= m and m <= p)
                    return error("invalid estimate")
                task.estimate = [o, m, p]
                emit("pert {args[0]} expected {decimals(o + 4 * m + p, 6)} variance {decimals((p - o) ^ 2, 36)}")
            .tasks.set(args[0], task)
        elif command == "CAPACITY"
            .capacities.set(args[0], int(args[1]))
            emit("capacity {args[0]} {args[1]}")
        elif command == "START" or command == "HOLIDAY" or command == "DEADLINE"
            date := try parse_date(args[0])
            title := ""
            if command == "START"
                start_date = date
                title = "start"
            elif command == "DEADLINE"
                deadline_date = date
                title = "deadline"
            else
                if has_day(holidays, date)
                    return error("duplicate holiday {args[0]}")
                holidays = holidays.append(date)
                title = "holiday"
            emit("{title} {date_text(date)}")
        elif command == "LIST"
            emit("tasks {tasks.size()}, dependencies {#dependencies}, holidays {#holidays}")
            for name := task_names()[]
                WorkTask task := get_task(name)
                string[] previous := [for dep := pred_links(name)[] then dep.a]
                emit("{name} duration {task.current_duration()} resource {task.resource} units {task.units} preds {name_list(previous)}")
        elif command == "SHOW"
            try check_task(args[0])
            name := args[0]
            WorkTask task := get_task(name)
            emit("task {name} duration {task.current_duration()} resource {task.resource} units {task.units}" + (if task.not_before == 0 then "" else " notbefore {task.not_before}"))
            previous := [for dep := pred_links(name)[] then "{dep.a} {dep.kind}{signed_text(dep.lag)}"]
            following := [for dep := succ_links(name)[] then "{dep.b} {dep.kind}{signed_text(dep.lag)}"]
            emit("preds: " + (if #previous == 0 then "none" else previous.join(", ")))
            emit("succs: " + (if #following == 0 then "none" else following.join(", ")))
            emit("crash: " + (if task.crash_limit < 0 then "none" else "max {task.crash_limit} used {task.crashed} cost {task.crash_cost}"))
            emit("pert: " + (if #task.estimate == 0 then "none" else [for value := task.estimate[] then string(value)].join(" ")))
            string[] order := topological()
            if #order < tasks.size()
                emit("schedule: unavailable")
            else
                Schedule result := compute_schedule(order)
                labels := ["ES", "EF", "LS", "LF", "TF", "FF"]
                values := result.fields(name)
                fields := [for i := values.indices()[] then "{labels[i]} {values[i]}"]
                emit("schedule: {fields.join(" ")}" + (if result.critical(name) then " critical" else ""))
        elif command == "IMPACT"
            try check_task(args[0])
            string[] reached := []
            queue := [args[0]]
            nat at := 0
            while at < #queue
                current := queue[at]
                at += 1
                for dep := succ_links(current)[]
                    if not has_word(reached, dep.b)
                        reached = reached.append(dep.b)
                        queue = queue.append(dep.b)
            reached = [for name := reached[] if name != args[0] then name]
            emit("impact {args[0]}: {name_list(reached)}")
        else
            string[] order := try analysis_order()
            if command == "CALENDAR" and start_date < 0
                return error("no start date")
            if command == "LOAD" and not has_word(resources(), args[0])
                return error("unknown resource {args[0]}")
            if command == "WHATIF"
                try check_task(args[0])
            if command == "VARIANCE" and not baseline_set
                return error("no baseline")
            Schedule result := compute_schedule(order)
            string[] names := task_names()
            if command == "CPM"
                nat width := 4
                for name := names[]
                    if #name > width
                        width = #name
                string header := "TASK" + " " * (width - 4)
                for label := ["DUR", "ES", "EF", "LS", "LF", "TF", "FF"][]
                    header += " " * (5 - #label) + label
                emit(header)
                for: name := names[i]
                    string row := name + " " * (width - #name)
                    for value := [result.durations[i]].concat(result.fields(name))[]
                        text := string(value)
                        row += " " * (if #text < 5 then 5 - #text else 0) + text
                    emit(row + (if result.critical(name) then " *" else ""))
                emit("project duration {result.project_length}")
            elif command == "CRITICAL"
                string[][] paths := critical_paths(result)
                emit("critical paths: {#paths}")
                for path := paths[]
                    emit(path.join(" -> "))
            elif command == "SLACK"
                int[] seen := []
                for value := result.tf.sorted()[]
                    if not has_day(seen, value)
                        seen = seen.append(value)
                        emit("float {value}: " + [for i := names.indices()[] if result.tf[i] == value then names[i]].join(" "))
            elif command == "DRAG"
                for name := result.critical_names()[]
                    emit("{name} drag {result.project_length - compute_schedule(order, name, 0).project_length}")
            elif command == "STATS"
                critical := #result.critical_names()
                fs := #[for dep := dependencies[] if dep.kind == "FS" then dep]
                ss := #[for dep := dependencies[] if dep.kind == "SS" then dep]
                ff := #dependencies - fs - ss
                emit("tasks {tasks.size()}, critical {critical}, dependencies {#dependencies} (FS {fs}, SS {ss}, FF {ff})")
                string[] work := []
                for resource := resources()[]
                    total := 0
                    for name := names[]
                        WorkTask task := get_task(name)
                        if task.resource == resource
                            total += task.current_duration() * task.units
                    work = work.append("{resource} {total}")
                emit("work {work.join(", ")}")
                total := sum_numbers(result.tf)
                emit("float total {total}, average {decimals(total, int(#names))}")
                emit("duration {result.project_length}, critical share {decimals(100 * int(critical), int(#names))}%")
            elif command == "CALENDAR"
                calendar_report(result)
            elif command == "GANTT"
                if result.project_length > 60
                    return error("chart too wide ({result.project_length} days)")
                width := nat(maximum([for name := names[] then int(#name)]))
                digits := [for day := (0:<int(result.project_length))[] then string(day % 10)].join("")
                emit(" " * width + " |{digits}|")
                for name := result.by_start()[]
                    index := result.at(name)
                    bar := ""
                    for: day < result.project_length
                        if result.es[index] <= day and day < result.ef[index]
                            bar += if result.critical(name) then "=" else "-"
                        elif result.ef[index] <= day and day < result.lf[index]
                            bar += "."
                        else
                            bar += " "
                    emit(name + " " * (width - #name) + " |{bar}|")
            elif command == "LEVEL"
                try level_report(result, int(args[0]))
            elif command == "LOAD"
                int[] daily := usage(args[0], names, result.es, result.ef, result.project_length)
                peak := maximum(daily)
                nat day := 0
                while daily[day] != peak
                    day += 1
                emit("load {args[0]}: " + [for value := daily[] then string(value)].join(" "))
                emit("peak {peak} on day {day}")
                match capacities.get(args[0])
                    int capacity
                        exceeded := #[for value := daily[] if value > capacity then value]
                        emit("capacity {capacity} exceeded on {exceeded} days")
                    none
                        void
            elif command == "PERTSUM"
                for path := critical_paths(result)[]
                    mean := 0
                    variance := 0
                    for name := path[]
                        WorkTask task := get_task(name)
                        d := task.current_duration()
                        int[] estimate := if #task.estimate == 0 then [d, d, d] else task.estimate
                        mean += estimate[0] + 4 * estimate[1] + estimate[2]
                        variance += (estimate[2] - estimate[0]) ^ 2
                    emit("{path.join(" -> ")}: expected {decimals(mean, 6)} variance {decimals(variance, 36)}")
            elif command == "CRASH"
                .crash_project(order, int(args[0]))
            elif command == "WHATIF"
                replacement := int(args[1])
                Schedule after := compute_schedule(order, args[0], replacement)
                emit("whatif {args[0]} {get_task(args[0]).current_duration()} -> {replacement}: project {result.project_length} -> {after.project_length}")
                for: name := names[i]
                    string[] changes := []
                    old := [result.es[i], result.ef[i], result.tf[i]]
                    new := [after.es[i], after.ef[i], after.tf[i]]
                    labels := ["ES", "EF", "TF"]
                    for: nat j < 3
                        if old[j] != new[j]
                            changes = changes.append("{labels[j]} {old[j]}->{new[j]}")
                    if #changes > 0
                        emit("{name} {changes.join(" ")}")
                if result.critical_names() != after.critical_names()
                    emit("critical {result.critical_names().join(" ")} -> {after.critical_names().join(" ")}")
            elif command == "BASELINE"
                baseline = result
                baseline_set = true
                emit("baseline saved: {tasks.size()} tasks, duration {result.project_length}")
            elif command == "VARIANCE"
                emit("variance: duration {baseline.project_length} -> {result.project_length} ({signed_text(result.project_length - baseline.project_length)})")
                all := names
                for name := baseline.names[]
                    if not has_word(all, name)
                        all = all.append(name)
                printed := false
                for name := all.sorted()[]
                    nat old := baseline.at(name)
                    new := result.at(name)
                    if new == #names
                        emit("{name} removed")
                        printed = true
                    elif old == #baseline.names
                        emit("{name} new")
                        printed = true
                    elif baseline.es[old] != result.es[new] or baseline.ef[old] != result.ef[new]
                        emit("{name} start {signed_text(result.es[new] - baseline.es[old])} finish {signed_text(result.ef[new] - baseline.ef[old])}")
                        printed = true
                if not printed
                    emit("no task changes")
        return void

project := Project()

scan(&count)
for: i < count
    string line
    scan(&line)
    match .project.execute(line)
        void
            void
        error issue
